subject: Staggered incentive split and evaluation schedule for Alpha vs Bravo
messages:
From: Carlos Mendez <carlos@equivio.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@equivio.com
Date: 2027-05-20T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Evaluation credits — split between Alpha & Bravo teams?

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Equivio Health is planning a side-by-side evaluation across two product groups (Alpha and Bravo). Procurement asked whether Redwood can stage promotional credits so we can run parallel benchmarks without blowing our pilot budget. Ideally: 60% to Alpha (larger dataset, longer context), 40% to Bravo (quick throughput tests).

Timing: Alpha will start the week of Jun 7 and run 3 weeks. Bravo wants to begin Jun 14 for 2 weeks. Can Redwood do a staggered credit allocation and keep separate usage buckets so we can map costs per team? Any constraints on model/instance parity for the two cohorts?

Carlos
Equivio Health
[Attachment: evaluation_scope.pdf]
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos@equivio.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-20T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation credits — split between Alpha & Bravo teams?

Carlos — appreciate the detail and scope. We can absolutely do staggered allocations and isolate buckets by project tag so usage reports are per cohort. Quick proposal below (high level):

- Total promotional pool: 150k token-equivalent credits (we'll convert to usage units once team confirms model selection)
- Alpha: 90k (60%), start 2027-06-07, 3-week window
- Bravo: 60k (40%), start 2027-06-14, 2-week window
- Both cohorts: same model family (gptx-1-redwood) for parity; if Alpha needs higher context we can allocate larger instance types — will impact remaining credit burn rate.

Next steps from our side: can Ben and Lauren sign off on the credit schedule and I will push an MOA draft to procurement? I'll attach the SOW and a provisional credit schedule for review.

Thanks — Priyom
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: credit-schedule.xlsx]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-21T09:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation credits — split between Alpha & Bravo teams?

Looping in Lauren for formal approval. From a sales ops perspective the split looks reasonable; couple of asks before we finalize:

1) Can we cap the sustained vCPU/GPU profile for Bravo to avoid unexpected burst costs? (Bravo's goal is throughput, they shouldn't need the large-context profile.)
2) Do we need a rollback plan if Alpha's usage outpaces the pool? Suggest we include a conditional top-up clause in the SOW (one-time discretionary top-up up to 20% subject to exec sign-off).

If Lauren signs off on the SOW language I can route the MOA to procurement.

-Ben
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW-draft.docx]
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-22T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation credits — split between Alpha & Bravo teams?

Ben / Priyom — OK to proceed with the proposed split. I concur with capping Bravo's profile; please enumerate the exact instance caps in the SOW (e.g., max 2x A100-equivalent per job for Bravo). Approve the conditional top-up clause but call out approval authority (VP Sales + Finance) and a 14-day notice window.

I'll add a finance clause to the SOW that requires usage reporting at the cohort tag level and a reconciliation call within 10 business days of pilot close. Once Ben routes the MOA to procurement I'll add the finance contact in CC.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Deals Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos@equivio.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-24T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Final MOA & credit staging — Equivio Health (DEAL-2027-0783)

Hi all — attaching the final MOA and an updated credit-schedule.xlsx with instance caps and the conditional top-up language included per Lauren's notes. Summary of changes:

- Alpha: 90k credits, gptx-1-redwood, up to 4x A100-equivalent for peak runs, scheduled 2027-06-07 to 2027-06-28
- Bravo: 60k credits, gptx-1-redwood (throughput profile), capped at 2x A100-equivalent per job, scheduled 2027-06-14 to 2027-06-28
- Conditional top-up: up to 20% of total pool subject to VP Sales + Head of Finance approval, 14-day notice window
- Reporting: cohort-tagged usage CSV every 5 business days + final reconciliation call within 10 business days of close

Carlos — if procurement is OK with the MOA I'll send a DocuSign link today and we can create the two isolated credit buckets in our billing system once countersign is complete.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Pricing & Programs | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MOA_evaluation_terms.pdf]
